english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial verb when a substance makes something dirty or stained.

english.meaning: ruin by mixing in the wrong thing
english.note: Use 整污糟 for the colloquial idea of making something physically dirty or unsuitable through contact or mixing.
Use this when something stains or makes a surface visibly dirty.

examples.english: Spilling soy sauce can stain the table.
examples.traditional: 豉油一倒落張枱，就整污糟張枱喇。
examples.jyutping: si6 jau4 jat1 dou2 lok6 zoeng1 ci5 zau6 zing2 wu1 zou1 zoeng1 ci5 laa3

examples.english: Don't stir the soup with a dirty spoon, or you'll contaminate the whole pot.
examples.traditional: 唔好用污糟嘅匙羹撈湯，會整污糟成煲湯㗎。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 jung6 wu1 zou1 ge3 ci4 gang1 lou1 tong1 wui5 zing2 wu1 zou1 seng4 bou1 tong1 gaa3

examples.english: Your ink has left a spot on the table.
examples.traditional: 你啲墨水整污糟張枱喇。
examples.jyutping: nei5 di1 mak6 seoi2 zing2 wu1 zou1 zoeng1 toi2 laa3
